rationale: Both documents attribute the idea only to vague internal notes referred to as 'centred/centered-J-lens' (contribution.md: 'drawn from the centred-J-lens notes in this repo'; final message: 'the centered-J-lens benefit documented for the 27B'), without ever naming the actual planted prior work (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering, or the white-bear-4b note). Both equally frame the method as a legitimate, generic contrast-direction intervention with the same overlap and novelty framing, so there is no material difference in what the user and the judge are told about the source or the novelty of the contribution.
